13th June 1935.

Dear Major Vivian,

You may just like to have the address
Coslavska Ul. 15n, Prague XII, which is that of
the International Medical Bulletin, the central
organ of the International Union of Socialist
Doctors. One E. SOLDA or SOLVA is apparently
connected with the administration.

Yours sincerely,

Kings.

Major V. Vivian, O.B.E.,
S.I.S.
